explication: Fasten OnPrem is a self-hosted personal health record for viewing and managing health information, not a direct provider-import service. The main user journey is to sign in, enter records or upload an exported FHIR bundle, then explore records and dashboards. The frontend talks to a Go API whose documented routes cover authentication, FHIR resources, summaries, jobs, and settings; backend repositories provide persistence. The graph follows documented capabilities and indexed references. Several handlers and service implementations were not sampled, so uncertain internal call links are omitted.
